integrity: Ordered quadruple counts are established by an explicit finite-ring proof; modular checks are supplementary, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The exact result applies to odd moduli. The prime-field layer was previously known; the focus is higher odd prime powers and their Chinese-remainder product. Completeness of priority searches is uncertain; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Exact additive energy of modular hyperbolas at every odd modulus
